name: Rugby Run Solar Farm
notable: 126 MW solar farm near Chinchilla, QLD. Developed by FRV (Abdul Latif Jameel). Has a PPA with AGL Energy.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Rugby Run Solar Farm — Development Application (Isaac Regional Council MCU, May 2017); Adani Renewables (Bravus)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Ergon 66 kV network near Moranbah (Central QLD)
eis_specs.notes: Adani Renewables (rebranded Bravus). Stage 1 65 MW; MCU envelope approved for up to 170 MW total. 247,000 PV modules on single-axis trackers near Moranbah, Central QLD. Isaac Regional Council MCU May 2017; opened Oct 2019.
